changelog:
Initial release of comic-guide-skill.

- Generate AI-illustrated comic-style educational guides from technical content, documentation, or source code.
- Produces multi-panel comic PNG images in over 10 anime and cartoon styles, including Doraemon, Naruto, One Piece, Dragon Ball, Ghibli, and more.
- Each chapter outputs a comic image with drawn characters, speech bubbles, and cartoon-style technical diagrams.
- Flexible workflow: analyze content, build storyboards, define characters, generate prompts, and output comic images.
- Supports custom styles, storyboard/prompt-only modes, and both Chinese and English outputs.
